text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
My enthusiasm for the upcoming Japan Cup, 
you ask—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it. Out of all the moments I've 
sprinted through up until now, power is 
welling up within me more intensely than 
ever before.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And, that my heart is throbbing with such 
excitement that it trembles!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
With everything I have right now, I will 
definitely—show you I can win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This declaration from Almond Eye greatly 
heightened the race fans' interest in the 
Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
The lineup gathering for the Japan Cup is 
unbelievable. It really feels like the 
race of the century.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And in the middle of all this, Almond 
Eye's declaration of peak form! Man, that 
gave me chills! What kind of race will she 
show us?!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"For the one who changed history, her fans 
hold only a single wish—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Keep showing us even bigger dreams, time 
and again! Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...―― 'The race of the century, the Japan 
Cup.'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
On the radio, on TV, on the internet... 
Everyone's talking about Ai-san non-stop.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san included, everyone must be honing 
their absolute best for that day."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If I am to claim the solitary golden 
flower from among this crowd—I must 
challenge it like never before.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the training load... would it be 
possible to push it to the absolute limit?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I do have a fair amount of stamina. Please 
let me make the most of this body and 
train as hard as I can.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind if it's a workload one step 
beyond what seems to be my limit. I—I will 
definitely see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I had carelessly forgotten her true 
nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even during the Classic Year, when she was 
constantly outshone by her peers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And so, I want to build momentum and take 
on the Senior Year...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when tackling the towering wall known 
as the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I wish to put this body to use to achieve 
a great feat. A special feat worthy of 
earning a special flower.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Because I felt... that if it's me, I can 
do it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was an Umamusume who was boundlessly 
strong, supple, and utterly refused to 
know the meaning of giving up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I will dedicate it to you, without fail. 
That is why, please—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Could you ever forgive my selfishness?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll do everything in my power as well. So 
that she can gather her bouquet of golden 
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And to show the world that Curren 
Bouquetd'or is indeed an Umamusume whose 
brilliance will shine into the far-off 
future—!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Joint training, huh? Sounds good to me!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'd love your help over here too! ...Wait, 
you already came up with the menu?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh... If that's what you're doing, I know 
a good training camp facility. It's run by 
a teacher who helped me out back in the 
day, butâ

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
2400m on turf—looking forward to working 
with you today. My girls have been eagerly 
awaiting this as well.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Let's hold a meeting in the club room 
after the race. We can help each other 
pinpoint areas for improvement.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I took a look at the data. She's getting 
into shape, but I get the impression her 
lower body still needs more 
strengthening."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Could you add your meal and sleep times, 
and send the data again...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...We wait here? Just what on earth is—

text_block_list.name: Fans on Monitor
text_block_list.text:
“Curren Bouquetd'or and Trainer! Do your 
best in the Japan Cup~!”

text_block_list.name: Fans on Monitor
text_block_list.text:
"I'm always encouraged by seeing you give 
it your all!" "Work hand in hand with your 
Trainer and seize victory!" "You can 
definitely win this, Bouquet-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
All the monitors in front of the station, 
all at once... What is this—?!
choice_data_list: Your fans all have a surprise for you!
Your fans all have a surprise for you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Something like this—did you arrange it for 
me, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was only told about the surprise itself 
in advance, and knew nothing about the 
preparations."
choice_data_list:
Your earnest dedication is what inspired 
them to do that.

Your earnest dedication is what moved 
them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just a surprise. So many 
different people—truly, all kinds of 
people—naturally lent their strength in 
preparation for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No—it is the sight of your untiring 
efforts that has truly moved everyone's 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That is very... rare. And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who has lent us a hand is surely 
praying for our victory.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's only one thing we 
ought to do—!
choice_data_list:
Let's give it our all in the "Japan Cup." 
Let's exceed expectations.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, surely...! Beyond all expectations, I 
will gather up our victories—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And finally—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Here it is! The Japan Cup—!

text_block_list.name: Ai's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so hyped for Ai-chan's race!! By the 
way, who was that declaration of war even 
meant for anyway?

text_block_list.name: Bouquet Fan
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, please! Grant Bouquet-chan 
and Trainer the greatest brilliance 
today...!!

text_block_list.name: Bouquet Fans
text_block_list.text: "Do your best! Bouquet, and Trainer <username>!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ai-senpai. I know very well how strong 
you are. However—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
As a Triple Tiara Umamusume, and as an 
Umamusume representing my home— I will 
surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *Inhaaaale*... *exhaaaale*... ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I can hear your voices. Everyone's 
heartfelt cheers—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'll be going now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That's a great expression.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...It is not that I am overflowing with 
confidence. After all, my opponent is you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Don't be modest. —Though I won't step 
aside. Because Almond Eye does not lose.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Today, I am certain you will seize a 
single bloom of victory more dazzling than 
anything else.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"With those in hand, I want to bind a 
golden bouquet. One that I must, without 
fail, dedicate to him."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"With those in hand, I want to bind a 
golden bouquet. One that I must, without 
fail, dedicate to her."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even if so many people are wishing for 
your victory.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Above all, even if it hinders your very 
own— desire to "win."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Even if it makes you—cry.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "I want to win. I want to seize—glory."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That is what I firmly believe right now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I really do adore you after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
To have someone as kind as you feel that 
way... It's such an honor. I'm so, so 
thrilled—!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Then I definitely have to win. Otherwise, 
I'll regret it for the rest of my life."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Let's go! To the greatest "Japan Cup"â

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I will beat Curren Bouquetd'or!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This has become the ultimate showdown, 
truly the race of the century! The Japan 
Cup is about to get underway!
